pages.title: The bookshop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold afternoon in the center of London. Gus walks into a small bookshop. The shelf by the door is full of old novels. His friend Tamara holds a worn book. She smiles when she sees him. Gus asks about the book in her hand.
“Tamara, is this the book which changed your life?” says Gus. “Yes, it is a novel which I read when I was fifteen.” says Tamara. “What is it about? I want a story which makes me think.” says Gus.
